theorems.name: Submission.exists_smooth_approx_testField_fderiv
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (U : Set (Ambient n ℓ)) (X : Ambient n ℓ → Ambient n ℓ), IsOpen U → IsTestField U X → ∃ (K : Set (Ambient n ℓ)) (Y : ℕ → Ambient n ℓ → Ambient n ℓ), IsCompact K ∧ K ⊆ U ∧ tsupport X ⊆ K ∧ (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ ∞ (Y k) ∧ HasCompactSupport (Y k) ∧ tsupport (Y k) ⊆ K) ∧ TendstoUniformly (fun k ↦ fderiv ℝ (Y k)) (fderiv ℝ X) atTop
